title: Selective targeting of skeletal muscle resident fibro-adipogenic progenitors via recombinant adeno-associated viral delivery
task: Develop AAV system for selective in vivo targeting of skeletal muscle FAPs
key_results: AAV5 with 826 bp Pdgfra promoter achieved optimal FAP specificity with minimal off-target expression in myofibers, endothelial cells, immune cells, and satellite cells
comments: Demonstrates practical translational potential for FAP-targeted gene therapy, though long-term safety and efficacy in disease models remain to be tested.

model_io.model: AAV5/AAV8 serotypes with Pdgfra promoter variants
inputs: Pdgfra promoter (full-length 2.2 kb and truncated 826 bp)
outputs: minimal off-target expression in myofibers and mononucleated populations

model_io.model: Intramuscular AAV injection in murine tibialis anterior

hypotheses.hypothesis: Truncated Pdgfra promoter provides higher gene expression than full-length promoter
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 826 bp promoter outperformed 2.2 kb construct

hypotheses.hypothesis: AAV5 provides superior FAP specificity compared to AAV8
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AAV5 with 826 bp Pdgfra promoter achieved optimal specificity

title: Fibroblast activation protein-targeted near-infrared labeling of cancer-associated fibroblasts in a non-small-cell lung cancer tumor microenvironment
task: Develop FAP-targeted near-infrared fluorophore for intraoperative imaging of NSCLC-associated fibroblasts
key_results: FAPL-S0456 binds FAP-expressing CAFs with high affinity (Kd ~12.1 × 10⁻⁷ M) and achieves signal-to-background ratios up to 12.67 ± 4.5 in xenografts; no uptake in FAP-negative tumors or normal lung tissue
comments: This approach cleverly targets the stromal microenvironment rather than heterogeneous tumor cell receptors, offering potential universality across NSCLC subtypes, though clinical translation requires validation in patient-derived samples.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FAP is a selective marker of CAFs in NSCLC tumor microenvironment absent in normal lung
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FAPL-S0456 showed no fluorescence in normal lung tissue

hypotheses.hypothesis: FAP-targeted imaging provides universal applicability across NSCLC subtypes
hypotheses.result: Supported; labeling observed independent of tumor histological subtype when CAFs present

title: KIAA1429 promotes gallbladder cancer progression through m6A-dependent post-transcriptional modification of KIF20A
task: Elucidate role of m6A methyltransferase KIAA1429 in gallbladder cancer progression
key_results: KIAA1429 knockdown substantially impaired proliferation, migration, and invasion in vitro and suppressed xenograft tumor growth; KIF20A identified as KIAA1429 downstream effector via MeRIP-seq
comments: The mechanistic link between KIAA1429-mediated m6A methylation and KIF20A stability/translation is inferred but direct evidence of m6A-dependent regulation on KIF20A mRNA is not explicitly detailed.

model_io.model: GBC cell lines with KIAA1429 knockdown/overexpression

outputs: tumor growth suppression upon KIAA1429 knockdown

hypotheses.hypothesis: KIAA1429 upregulation drives GBC progression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; elevated KIAA1429 correlates with aggressive phenotype and poor survival

hypotheses.hypothesis: KIAA1429 promotes malignant phenotypes through KIF20A regulation
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; KIF20A overexpression rescued proliferation/invasion deficits from KIAA1429 knockdown

title: Fuzzy K-means–based outlier detection in plastic-degradation-related protein sequences using PSI-BLAST, Jaccard similarity, and OMA features
task: Identify functional outliers in plastic-degrading protein sequences
key_results: Fuzzy k-means integrating PSI-BLAST, Jaccard similarity, and OMA scores achieved 24.5% improvement in outlier detection (151 vs 200 outliers)
comments: Combining evolutionary and functional metrics enhances precision; knowledge graph visualization aids candidate prioritization for novel catalytic functions.

model_io.model: Fuzzy k-means clustering with PSI-BLAST + Jaccard + OMA features
inputs: protein sequences related to plastic degradation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-metric feature integration improves outlier detection precision compared to single-metric approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PSI-BLAST alone identified 200 outliers, PSI-BLAST+Jaccard+OMA identified 151, suggesting weaker-similarity proteins as novel candidates

title: Feature extraction from real-world polysomnography reports of obstructive sleep apnea cohort using large language model
task: Extract structured clinical features from unstructured image-based PSG reports
key_results: ChatGPT-3.5 reliably extracted features with error reduction through improved prompts; two-phase OCR+LLM approach substantially enhanced extraction efficiency
comments: Practical application of LLMs to EHR digitization, though extensive testing across document quality variations is acknowledged as needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Computer vision and LLMs can efficiently extract features from text-containing image documents
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; most errors were numerical/encoding-related and correctable via prompt refinement

title: Dynamic structured pruning and merging for real-time acceleration of reinforcement learning
task: Accelerate reinforcement learning training and inference via dynamic structured pruning and model merging
key_results: Framework reduces cumulative training FLOPs by up to 72% while maintaining performance parity with dense baselines; average inference latency reduction of 16.2%
comments: Structured pruning addresses hardware compatibility gap missing from prior unstructured DRL approaches; periodic merging stabilizes training against catastrophic forgetting.

model_io.model: Dynamic structured pruning + model merging framework

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic structured pruning with periodic model merging prevents training instability while enabling real-time hardware acceleration in DRL
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; up to 72% FLOP reduction and 16.2% latency reduction achieved with performance maintained across majority of continuous control environments

title: Profiling fungal secondary metabolites with anti-leishmanial activity: an integrated in silico and in vitro study
task: Drug discovery against Leishmania major via computational screening and validation of fungal secondary metabolites
key_results: Dihydrocitrinone identified as lead antileishmanial compound with binding free energy ΔG=-35.41 kcal/mol, IC50 9.87 µM (promastigotes), 26.29 µM (amastigotes), and 86% apoptosis induction at IC50
comments: First experimental validation of dihydrocitrinone against L. major; moderate selectivity (SI=2.8) and apoptotic mechanism support scaffold optimization for leishmaniasis therapeutics.

model_io.model: Homology modeling + virtual screening + molecular dynamics + in vitro assays

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fungal secondary metabolites targeting L. major CYP51 exhibit antileishmanial activity through apoptosis induction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dihydrocitrinone showed strong computational predictions and experimental validation with potent IC50 and 86% apoptosis in treated cells

title: Morphology-keyed secure representation learning for privacy-preserving ECG arrhythmia classification and signal recovery
task: Privacy-preserving ECG arrhythmia classification with signal recoverability
key_results: Morphology-keyed secure representation learning achieved 98.6% accuracy, 97.6% F1-score, and low reconstruction error on MIT-BIH database
comments: Elegantly integrates cardiac morphology-aware encryption with interpretability; lightweight latent-space protection preserves both privacy and diagnostic utility.

model_io.model: Morphology-keyed secure representation learning + self-recoverable decoder
inputs: raw ECG signals from MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (5 heartbeat categories)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Signal-dependent morphology keys provide effective privacy protection without sacrificing diagnostic accuracy or recoverability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 98.6% classification accuracy with low reconstruction error and preserved interpretability in secured latent space

title: Sensory-driven neck–limb coordination mechanisms for walk-trot-gallop gait transitions
task: Model sensory-driven neural mechanisms governing quadruped gait transitions
key_results: Neural network model reproduces walk-trot-gallop transitions via single speed parameter using GRF and trunk angular velocity; gait metrics (speed, neck amplitude, peak GRF, stability) match actual animal kinematics
comments: Demonstrates that distributed CPG networks with peripheral sensory feedback generate adaptive whole-body coordination; applicable to biomechanics and robot locomotion design.

model_io.model: CPG-based neural network with sensory feedback

hypotheses.hypothesis: Self-organized neck-limb coordination emerges from CPG-sensory feedback mechanisms in response to speed-driven gait transitions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; simulated gait metrics show similar tendencies to actual animals across locomotor types

title: CCC-MMTN: towards robust classification of confusable modulations in few-shot scenarios
task: Few-shot automatic modulation classification under signal-to-noise ratio variation
key_results: Complex-valued circular convolutional meta multi-task network achieved 77.35% accuracy with 5 samples per modulation type (-20 to 18 dB) and 84.09% with 7 types (50 samples, random SNR)
comments: Meta-learning effectively handles limited data; alternating local-global training strengthens robustness, though evaluation remains on single synthetic dataset (RML2016.10a).

model_io.model: CCC-MMTN (complex-valued circular convolutional meta multi-task network)
inputs: raw communication signals at varying SNR (RML2016.10a dataset)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Meta-learning with multi-task knowledge transfer enables discrimination of confusable modulations under few-shot conditions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 77.35% accuracy achieved with only 5 samples per type across SNR range; physical validation confirmed 84.09% real-world performance

title: Development and validation of interpretable machine learning models to predict 30-day mortality in patients with intracerebral hemorrhage
task: Develop interpretable machine learning models for early 30-day mortality prediction in intracerebral hemorrhage
key_results: LightGBM model achieved AUC 0.859 (internal test, n=444) and AUC 0.811 (temporal validation, n=339) with good calibration (Brier scores 0.132 and 0.174 respectively)
comments: Robust temporal validation on MIMIC-III CareVue demonstrates generalization; SHAP interpretability and deployed web tool support clinical integration, though multicenter geographic external validation remains lacking.

inputs: clinical variables from first 24h post-ICH admission (MIMIC-IV/III)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Machine learning models trained on MIMIC-IV imaging-free clinical data generalize to temporally distinct MIMIC-III cohort for 30-day ICH mortality prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LightGBM maintained AUC 0.811 and acceptable calibration on temporal validation set, supporting clinical utility

title: BeMapper: BicNet and evolutionary-based multi-agent path planning with effective reinforcement
task: Multi-agent path planning in dynamic warehouse environments via evolutionary-augmented RL
key_results: BeMapper achieves 98.66% mean success rate vs. Mapper (95.51%) and BicNet (93.78%); average reward 18.81 vs. Mapper 18.81 and BicNet 0.04; 36 average travel steps (5–9 steps shorter than baselines)
comments: Well-motivated hybrid combining bidirectional fusion, evolutionary critic selection, and multi-metric scoring; the near-zero BicNet reward is anomalous and warrants clarification.

model_io.model: BeMapper (BicNet + distributed actor-critic + evolutionary critic selection)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Evolutionary critic selection + bidirectional fusion resolves training instability and improves credit assignment
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; BeMapper outperforms Mapper (3.15%) and BicNet (4.88%) in success rate; substantially higher reward (18.81 vs. 0.04)

title: A sustainable driven intrusion detection model for green CPS using ISP analysis and energy aware deep ensemble learning
task: Intrusion detection for green cyber-physical systems via ISP-aware ensemble learning
key_results: ISP-aware framework achieves 99.0654% accuracy on network data and 99.4523% on IoT data; incorporating ISP analysis significantly enhances IDS reliability and resilience
comments: ISP (Inconsistent Sequential Pattern) concept is domain-relevant for CPS anomaly detection; very high accuracies warrant independent validation on different CPS deployments.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ISP analysis + ensemble learning improves green CPS intrusion detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 99.0654% (network) and 99.4523% (IoT) accuracies demonstrate significant improvement

title: Decentralized federated distillation for privacy-preserving cross-league basketball data collaboration
task: Privacy-preserving cross-league basketball analytics via decentralized federated distillation
key_results: Decentralized framework achieves 78.4% game-outcome accuracy (1.8 points behind centralized oracle) with 98% reduction in communication overhead; formal ε-differential-privacy guarantees via Laplace mechanism and Rényi-DP composition; Wasserstein transport aligns cross-league feature spaces into 64D shared representation
comments: Elegant theoretical framework combining federated distillation, differential privacy, and optimal transport; convergence analysis and empirical validation on four-league dataset (33,048 games) strengthen practical applicability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decentralized federated distillation with transport alignment and DP maintains oracle performance while preserving privacy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 78.4% accuracy (1.8 points gap), formal DP guarantees, 98% communication reduction

title: A blockchain-based governance layer for verifiable bid integrity in electricity market clearing
task: Verifiable bid integrity for centralized electricity market clearing via permissioned blockchain governance
key_results: Hybrid blockchain architecture enables post-clearing verification of order correspondence using cryptographic commitments on Hyperledger Fabric; achieves 176.5 transactions/sec on 46,643-order intraday market dataset; tamper-evident guarantees without centralized trust
comments: Clever use of permissioned blockchain for governance rather than decentralization; throughput (176.5 tx/sec) compatible with realistic auction windows but not real-time.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Blockchain governance layer verifies bid integrity without modifying clearing algorithm
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves one-to-one correspondence between submitted and committed orders, detects inconsistencies

title: Physics-informed-GPR data augmentation framework for flower-shaped antenna performance optimization and prediction using machine learning models
task: Antenna design optimization and MIMO performance prediction via physics-informed GPR data augmentation
key_results: PI-GPR framework expands 2,014 physics-consistent samples; Random Forest achieves R²=0.999, RMSE≤0.031 for resonant frequency and impedance bandwidth; optimized 2×2 MIMO achieves 6.22 dBi gain and ECC<0.0035
comments: Elegant integration of analytical modeling with data-driven ML eliminates expensive full-wave simulations; validation against CST/HFSS strengthens credibility.

model_io.model: Random Forest, ANN, Ridge Regression, Response Surface Methodology, Gradient Boosting

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-informed augmentation reduces simulation burden without accuracy loss
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RF achieves R²=0.999 with 2,014 augmented samples vs. exhaustive simulations

title: Hybrid temporal convolutional network-reservoir computing model for enhanced remaining useful life prediction in aerospace systems
task: Remaining useful life prediction in aerospace engines via hybrid TCN-reservoir computing
key_results: Hybrid model achieves RMSE 14.81–17.97 on NASA C-MAPSS subsets and PHM scores 57.1–446.73, outperforming standalone TCN and reservoir components
comments: Well-motivated architecture combining computational efficiency with long-term pattern capture; ablation analysis confirms hybrid benefit but limited comparison to recent LSTM/attention baselines.

inputs: engine sensor time-series from NASA C-MAPSS dataset

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid TCN-reservoir outperforms standalone architectures due to synergistic feature learning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; hybrid consistently exceeds standalone RMSE and PHM metrics

title: AFMap-UNet enables accurate nuclear segmentation of atomic force microscopy images with minimal training data
task: Nuclear segmentation in atomic force microscopy images via AFM-optical fusion with minimal training data
key_results: AFMap-UNet achieves 99% average precision and 96% median Dice coefficient on small training sets (15 images); integrates AFM topography with optical microscopy channels
comments: Impressive generalization with minimal data (15 images) via two-stage U-Net; first high-performance model for spatially resolved nuclear mechanics quantification.

hypotheses.hypothesis: AFM-optical fusion enables high-precision nuclear segmentation with minimal training data
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 99% AP and 96% Dice on 15-image training sets

title: An integrated dynamic-evaluation and multi-task deep learning framework for load forecasting and compressor scheduling in nonlinear industrial air systems
task: Integrated load forecasting and compressor scheduling for industrial compressed-air systems
key_results: PSO-LSTM forecasting + dynamic evaluation + multi-task NN achieves 9.26% reduction in specific energy consumption and 3.28% increase in effective operating ratio on top-50% data quality subset
comments: Practical framework coupling forecasting robustness with scheduling; dynamic evaluation module for data-quality tiering is novel but the choice of 50% threshold lacks principled justification.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Data-quality-aware training improves scheduling vs. full dataset
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 50% dataset yields best results (9.26% energy reduction vs. full)

title: A robust multi-criteria supplier evaluation in supply chain management using interval-valued bipolar q-fractional fuzzy aggregation operators
task: Multi-criteria supplier evaluation via interval-valued bipolar q-fractional fuzzy aggregation operators
key_results: Proposed model integrates bipolar (positive/negative membership), interval (expert imprecision), and q-fractional (flexible balance) fuzzy sets; two aggregation operators preserve idempotency, monotonicity, boundedness; sensitivity analysis confirms robust supplier rankings across parameter settings
comments: Mathematically rigorous framework addressing conflicting expert opinions and multi-faceted criteria; applicability demonstrated but lacks empirical comparison to classical multi-criteria methods (AHP, TOPSIS).

model_io.model: Interval-valued bipolar q-fractional fuzzy weighted averaging operator
inputs: supplier evaluation criteria (positive and negative aspects)

model_io.model: Interval-valued bipolar q-fractional fuzzy weighted geometric operator

hypotheses.hypothesis: Proposed fuzzy model handles interval, bipolar, and fractional control simultaneously for robust supplier ranking
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; systematic ranking and sensitivity analysis show stable results across parameter settings

title: Investigation of nano-particle effects on cold storage performance using finite element modeling
task: Nanoparticle optimization for cold energy storage via finite element modeling
key_results: Optimal nanoparticle diameter increases solidification rate by 20%; nanoparticle dispersion shortens total freezing duration by 41.23%; adaptive Galerkin FEM accurately captures freezing front transience
comments: Systematic numerical assessment of diameter and concentration effects is thorough; physical validation against experiments strengthens thermal model credibility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimal nanoparticle size significantly improves freezing performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 20% solidification rate increase and 41.23% reduction in freezing duration

title: A ridge-isolated tuned mass damper for seismic rehabilitation of a 3D structure under bidirectional earthquakes
task: Seismic control optimization for structures via tuned mass damper isolation
key_results: RITMD system reduces displacements, accelerations, inter-story drifts, and torsional demands under bidirectional earthquakes; PSO-based optimization derives closed-form design expressions
comments: Practical engineering contribution combining vibration isolation with optimization; applicability to retrofitting is valuable but numerical comparison metrics against baselines would strengthen claims.

inputs: coupled dynamics of primary structure and damper

hypotheses.hypothesis: RITMD integrating isolation and damping reduces structural responses more than standalone approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via nonlinear time-history analysis; significant reductions in RMS values

title: Analysis and experimental verification of the energy transfer mechanism in particle dampers for vibration reduction
task: Characterizing energy dissipation mechanisms in particle damper configurations
key_results: USPD kinetic-energy-dominated with superior high-frequency performance; TDMPD achieves optimal damping at low frequency; acoustic radiation efficiency drops significantly at high frequencies
comments: The study identifies three distinct energy pathways but lacks detailed quantification of efficiency ratios across the frequency spectrum.

model_io.model: Single-degree-of-freedom vibration platform with particle dampers (USPD, ODMPD, TDMPD)

hypotheses.hypothesis: USPD dissipates energy through directional collisions in high-frequency regime
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—USPD shows superior performance at high frequency due to rapid response

hypotheses.hypothesis: TDMPD relies on inter-particle friction and achieves optimal damping at low frequency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—strong nonlinearity enables optimal low-frequency performance

title: Star-patterned FSS-assisted multi-step notched antenna for enhancing circular polarization, gain, and impedance matching
task: Enhancing X-band antenna performance using star-patterned FSS integration
key_results: Gain improvement from 3.77 dBi to 7.31 dBi; reflection coefficient of -38.4 dB at 9.8 GHz; enhanced impedance matching and circular polarization stability
comments: The FSS design effectively compensates for FR4 substrate losses, but the trade-off between substrate cost and performance degradation remains a practical limitation.

model_io.model: Multi-step notched FR4 antenna with star-shaped FSS (1.44λ₀ × 1.44λ₀ × 1.6 mm³)
inputs: FSS unit cell shape and dimensions

hypotheses.hypothesis: FSS integration improves broadside radiation and reduces backward radiation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—gain increased by 3.54 dBi through enhanced broadside field reinforcement

hypotheses.hypothesis: Star-shaped FSS enhances angular stability of circular polarization in principal planes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed—demonstrated broader angular stability across principal planes
